torch_dense_co2.context: At 5–25km 14.9–66.65 bar from VIRA table; 30km 9.581 bar; 40km 3.501 bar; 50km 1.066 bar.
torch_dense_co2.conclusion: NO published GW fusion magnetic-nozzle proof at 1–70 bar CO2. Magnetic nozzle vacuum PIC/neutrals cannot be extrapolated to dense neutral CO2; collisional momentum/ionization, entrainment, pressure separation, base recirculation, radiation, coil/nozzle heat, bearing and hull heating OPEN. Raising rotor handover to 30–50km increases rotor tipjet heat substantially.
